guards.entry_guide: shorts at 0.15 to 0.20 delta, wings 200 to 400 points out
guards.order_sequence: buy legs first; buy back shorts before selling hedges

situations.name: Gap at the open
situations.rule: Wait until 09:30 before suggesting, unless a short opens in the money

situations.name: Trending day
situations.rule: Show early rolls when net delta grows past 0.15 per lot

situations.name: Range day
situations.rule: Show only the profit target; no adjustments

situations.name: IV jumps without a big move
situations.rule: Show where the P&L came from; suggest No change unless an event is within 1 session

situations.name: IV crush after an event
situations.rule: Show take-profit at 40% of max profit

situations.name: Afternoon carry check
situations.rule: At 15:00: show overnight margin and the loss at +/-2% gap

situations.name: Expiry day
situations.rule: From 13:00: buy back shorts below Rs 2; close a position whose short is within 0.3% by 14:30; warn about STT on in-the-money options

situations.name: Broker or data outage
situations.rule: No suggestion; show the last good data and its age

situations.name: Adjustment limit reached
situations.rule: Only exit and reduce are offered

situations.name: Big win early
situations.rule: If profit reaches 40% of max profit on day 1, show take profit

T-01.label: Spot within this % of a short strike

T-01b.label: Spot within this many points of a short strike

T-04.label: Net delta beyond +/- this per lot

T-05.label: One side's value is this many x the other side's

T-06.label: Loss reaches this % of max loss

T-06b.label: Loss reaches this many x the credit received

T-07.label: Profit reaches this % of max profit

T-08.label: A leg's premium reaches this many x its entry (leg stop)

T-09.label: A short leg's premium falls below Rs (close for pennies)

T-10b.label: Clock time reached (checked in this stage)

T-11.label: Options' IV changed this many points since entry

T-12.label: Spot has moved this many expected moves (SD) since entry

T-13.label: Gap at the open of at least this %

T-14.label: Loss from a 1% move (gamma) at least this % of margin

T-14t.label: Theta per day falls below this % of premium left

T-14v.label: Loss from +1 IV point (vega) at least this % of max profit

T-15.label: Margin used reaches this % of available

T-16.label: Loss reaches this % of the margin blocked

T-18.label: Adjustments used reach the plan's maximum

T-19.label: Premium still left to earn is below this many x the adjustment's cost

T-20.label: Spot crosses a level you set (support / resistance)

T-21.label: Prices stale or missing (no suggestion is made)

situations.name: Afternoon carry check
situations.rule: At 15:00: show overnight margin and the loss at +/-2% gap

situations.name: Expiry day
situations.rule: From 13:00: buy back shorts below Rs 2; close a position whose short is within 0.3% by 14:30; warn about STT on in-the-money options

situations.name: Broker or data outage
situations.rule: No suggestion; show the last good data and its age

situations.name: Adjustment limit reached
situations.rule: Only exit and reduce are offered

situations.name: Big win early
situations.rule: If profit reaches 40% of max profit on day 1, show take profit
